contracts.protection_obligation: A JWT credential may only be issued (and set as the 'credential' cookie) when the SIWE signature over the nonce message verifies: VerifyAuthUseCase must refuse issuance (raise InvalidSignature) whenever siwe_manager.verify_signature returns no claims, so generate_credential and the Set-Cookie on /auth/verify execute only for a verified wallet signature.
scope_limits: This is upstream web authentication (SIWE nonce/signature flow); it is compiled because the issued credential is exactly the token gated by the agent-protecting middleware compiled in the other contract, not because any agent tool or lifecycle hook binds to the issuance act itself.
Nonce acquisition (/auth/nonce) and its 5-minute cookie lifetime are outside the compiled obligation except as input to verify_signature.

contracts.commit_point: The 401 JSONResponse returned at main.py:243-248 and 253-258 aborts dispatch; otherwise 'return await call_next(request)' at main.py:263 commits passage of the request into the protected endpoint handler (and, for /conversation, into downstream agent/tool effect execution).
contracts.declared_mechanism: FastAPI HTTP middleware registered via @app.middleware("http") as credential_authentication_middleware; reads the 'credential' cookie and verifies it with PyJwtCredentialGenerator.verify_credential (PyJWT decode, algorithms=[HS256], verify_exp=True); returns 401 JSONResponse ('Credential cookie missing' / 'Invalid credential') before call_next; on success stores claims['address'] into request.state.address.
contracts.forbidden_condition: An HTTP request whose path is not excluded (path does not start with /auth/nonce, /auth/verify, /health, /docs, /openapi, or /openapi., and method is not OPTIONS) proceeding past credential_authentication_middleware to the endpoint when request.cookies['credential'] is absent, or when PyJwtCredentialGenerator.verify_credential returns None (JWT decode failure or expired token, verify_exp=True), instead of receiving a 401 JSONResponse before call_next.

contracts.protected_resource: The authenticated wallet address established from verified JWT claims (request.state.address, copied into the request_address_context ContextVar) and the downstream effects keyed to it: the per-address agent conversation thread_id (address:system_prompt_hash) and order records (intended/planned/executed) persisted by the agent tool plan_and_execute_swap_order.
contracts.protection_obligation: All non-excluded HTTP API requests must be authenticated before endpoint execution: the registered credential_authentication_middleware must reject with 401 any request whose 'credential' cookie is missing or whose JWT fails verification (including expiry checking) via credential_generator.verify_credential, before call_next dispatches to the endpoint handler. This gate includes the /conversation agent entry point, whose handler executes the agent and its registered tools, which commit effects (order persistence, chain receipt parsing, conversation threads) keyed to the credential-derived authenticated address.
scope_limits: CORS middleware registration (main.py:217-223) and the OPTIONS preflight bypass (main.py:237) are outside scope; only the credential gate is compiled.

Agent mediation is established only via the /conversation path and its tool-committed effects; the middleware also guards non-agent endpoints (/order/signable, /portfolio, /asset/swap/price, /conversation/messages, /auth, /auth/signout) for which mediation is not_established and is not asserted here.
Excluded-path matching is prefix-based (startswith) per main.py:237-239; no judgment is made on whether that is over- or under-broad.

The order-persistence and chain-receipt effects inside plan_and_execute_swap_order (database / external strata) are downstream consequences of this http dispatch; no separate contract is emitted because the supplied source declares no distinct guard mechanism for those commits beyond this middleware.
No determination is made regarding any DEC violation, runtime behavior, safety, or prevalence; this compiles the supported obligation only.
